result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the module compiles offline. I did not check the runtime behaviour: the `java` invocations and `git diff` were blocked by approval prompts, so the help output and the report generation are unverified. Nothing was committed.

What changed:

- **`Commands.java`**: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION` (the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`). The no-argument overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` with the same landscape options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch sends both names to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method, so options and behaviour are shared. For `-help`, the usage line uses the command name the user typed, and the description is picked by name, so `updateLandscape -help` keeps its original description.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Commands" section covering both names. This is an addition, not an edit of existing text.

Verification: `mvn -o -pl cli test-compile` succeeded. The cli module has no tests, so I did not run any. I also did not run `analyzeLandscape -help` or `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` end to end. If you want that checked, run `java -jar cli/target/cli-1.0-jar-with-dependencies.jar analyzeLandscape -help` after rebuilding the jar.
